_comment: Tax return result template. Only sections relevant to the taxpayer's situation are included. Field names MUST match what generate_tax_pdf.py expects.

meta._note_exchange_rates: Keys are currency codes, e.g. {"EUR": 1.08}. generate_tax_pdf.py reads this first, falls back to exchange_rate_* keys.
meta._note_integrity: Skills should update _last_modified_by (skill name) and _last_modified_at (ISO timestamp) on every write. Subsequent skills should verify these fields to detect unexpected modifications.
meta._note_limitations: C2 manifest: what this return does NOT cover, copied verbatim from the /tax-compute capability gate (python3 agents/lib/capabilities.py --workspace . --json → limitations). /tax-generate prints it on page 1. Never empty after compute — it always carries at least the state-scope note.

form_1040._note_digital_asset: Form 1040 page-1 attestation. MUST be 'Yes' if the taxpayer received (reward/award/payment) OR sold/exchanged/disposed of any digital asset. /tax-parse-crypto sets this. Buying-and-holding with USD only is 'No'.
form_1040._note_refundable_aotc: Form 8863 line 8 (40% refundable AOTC) — flows into line_33 even at $0 tax. Persisted at the 1040 level (like the excess-SS note below) so /tax-generate and /tax-verify can audit the refundable payment instead of it silently folding into line 33.
form_1040._note_excess_ss: Schedule 3 line 11: per-person compute_excess_ss_withholding() excess_credit sum (multi-employer over the wage base). Flows into line_31_schedule3_part2 -> line_33. Persisted here so /tax-generate and /tax-verify can audit the refundable payment instead of it silently folding into line 33.

_optional_sections_below: Include only if applicable to this taxpayer. Remove sections that don't apply.

schedule_a._include_if: compute_schedule_a ran and use_itemized is true (or the election was close enough to document — within $500)
schedule_a.note: Itemized deductions. Election computed by compute_schedule_a, not vibes.

schedule_ca_itemized._include_if: CA return and compute_ca_itemized ran (CA itemizes far more often than federal — small CA standard deduction, no SALT cap)
schedule_ca_itemized.note: CA Schedule CA itemized path. Independent of the federal election.

form_6251._include_if: has_iso_exercise flag is true, OR AMT applies, OR a prior-year Form 8801 carryforward exists
form_6251.note: AMT (v1: ISO-exerciser path). CA Schedule P NOT computed — see notes.
form_6251._note_iso_bargain: Input echo: sum of (box 4 FMV - box 3 strike) x box 5 shares across Form 3921s for shares HELD past year-end (same-year sales are W-2 income, not an AMT adjustment). The A2 tie-out compares the parse ledger's iso_bargain records against this figure.

form_2210._include_if: compute_form_2210 ran and no_penalty is false (an underpayment exists)
form_2210.note: Underpayment of estimated tax (1040 line 38). Computed by compute_form_2210 — regular method, even-withholding default; Schedule AI not modeled.

schedule_c._note_line_31: Positive = profit, negative = loss. Single field replaces dual profit/loss fields.

loss_carryforward_to_next_year._comment: Capital Loss Carryover Worksheet (Schedule D instructions): unused net loss carried to next year, split by character (ST offsets ST first). /tax-compute fills this using the loss actually usable this year ($3,000 / $1,500 MFS cap, less when taxable income is lower); /tax-rollover prefers this explicit block over deriving from line_16_combined.

crypto_summary._note: Crypto is PROPERTY (Notice 2014-21): wash-sale (§1091) does NOT apply. FIFO basis, universal per-asset pool (v1). Capital rows feed form_8949/schedule_d; ordinary_income.total feeds Schedule 1 line 8 (Schedule C + SE tax if mining/staking is a business).

foreign_source_income._note: Add named sub-keys per income source, e.g. bank_deposit_interest, savings_interest

form_8938_fatca._include_if: has_foreign_accounts flag is true — include even if not required (to document threshold analysis)

fbar_fincen_114._include_if: (has_foreign_accounts OR signature_authority_foreign_accounts flag is true) AND aggregate > $10K — signature-authority-only accounts count toward the aggregate and go on Part IV (31 CFR 1010.350)
fbar_fincen_114.note: Filed electronically at BSA E-Filing, not with tax return

form_1099r_401k_rollover._note_payer_tin: Payer TINs (EINs) are full numbers from the original 1099-R. Only INDIVIDUAL SSNs use last-4-only policy.

form_8995_qbi._include_if: has QBI income or REIT dividends

california_540._note_excess_sdi: Form 540 line 74: per-person compute_excess_sdi() when 2+ employers over-withheld SDI. TY2024+ (SB 951 removed the wage ceiling): always 0 / not applicable.

income_summary_by_person._note: IMPORTANT: Replace 'primary'/'spouse' keys with actual lowercase first names (e.g., 'john'/'jane'). generate_tax_pdf.py reads DATA['income_summary_by_person']['john'] — keys MUST match. Sub-fields are taxpayer-specific: add only income types that apply (e.g., 'interest_foreign' for foreign interest, 'consulting_gross' for Schedule C). The PDF generator uses .get(key, 0) so missing sub-fields default to $0.

form_8863._note: Form 8863 education credits — computed by compute_education_credits. nonrefundable_credit_schedule3_line3 flows to Schedule 3 line 3 (and reduces the CTC Credit Limit Worksheet amount); refundable_aotc_line29 flows to Form 1040 line 29 (payments — pays out at $0 tax). Per-student AOTC eligibility facts (half-time, first 4 years, <4 prior claims, no felony drug conviction) are user-asserted; qualified expenses are NET of tax-free scholarships/employer assistance/529 earnings per Pub 970.

form_8606._include_if: has_backdoor_roth or has_roth_conversion is true, OR taxpayer has nondeductible traditional-IRA basis (prior_year.ira_basis > 0 or a nondeductible contribution this year)
form_8606._note: Form 8606 Part I — nondeductible IRA basis and the pro-rata rule. Computed by compute_form_8606. taxable_to_1040 (line 15 + line 18) flows to Form 1040 line 4b. basis_remaining (line 14) is the carryforward /tax-rollover pulls into next year's prior_year.ira_basis.
